name: Bloodfury Bloodline
summary: In the Charred Vale, Maggran Earthbinder seeks to end the harpies’ hold. He sends you to kill their leader, Bloodfury Ripper, and bring back proof.

sections.title: Striking the Matron
sections.body: Harpies at the edge of the Charred Vale keep threatening Sun Rock Retreat. Maggran Earthbinder believes their attacks will only end when their matriarch, Bloodfury Ripper, is dead. The flock treats her like a queen, and her leadership gives them the unity and boldness they show along the craggy western ridge.

sections.title: Peace in the Earth
sections.body: Bloodfury Ripper’s remains are the proof Maggran asks you to bring back. With the brood queen gone, the harpies lose their order and become easier to keep at bay, easing the threat to Sun Rock Retreat. Her death also lifts Maggran’s burden of anger and constant watchfulness, leaving him free to seek the harmony and balance the tauren value.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Bloodfury Bloodline?
faq.answer: Maggran Earthbinder gives it. He leads Sun Rock Retreat and can be found near its pool of water.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be finished before this hunt unlocks?
faq.answer: You must first complete Harpies Threaten, in which Maggran sends you into the Charred Vale to thin the Bloodfury harpies’ ranks.
Bloodfury Ripper stalks the rocky hills along the northwestern edge of the Charred Vale. Her blue coloring sets her apart from the flock.

faq.q: Why does Maggran want Bloodfury Ripper dead?
faq.answer: Maggran sees Bloodfury Ripper as the queen guiding the harpies’ fierce expansion into the territory. He believes killing her will break their leadership and weaken their grip on the vale.

faq.q: How does Bloodfury Ripper's death affect the tauren of Sun Rock Retreat?
aliases: what happens when bloodfury ripper dies
faq.answer: Bloodfury Ripper’s death gives Maggran peace of mind. Freed from anger and dread of an attack, he can focus on healing the land.

faq.q: What is the quickest path to reach the Charred Vale from Sun Rock Retreat?
aliases: how to get to charred vale from sun rock
faq.answer: A mountain trail leads from the back of Sun Rock Retreat straight down into the Charred Vale, avoiding Stonetalon’s winding main roads.

angles.text: Stonetalon’s scarred land pains the tauren. With the violent harpy queen gone, elders like Maggran can turn their thoughts back to harmony and healing.
Protecting Sun Rock Retreat’s perimeter safeguards the Horde’s lone haven deep in the contested Stonetalon Mountains.
